model.theory: small-displacement linear elastic circular pipe members; nodal loads only; anchors restrain all six DOFs; pressure is a fixed right-hand side inside the active-set problem (R-4 §2.1)

section.note: c_m = c_a = 0: the nominal and reduced bases coincide; every stress value is the value of both basis families

model.pressure: caps p*A_i along the outward axis at transfers_to_wall terminals; none at separately_supported_or_compensated terminals; eps_p = (1-2nu) p A_i/(E A_n); N_w = S + p A_i
model.realized_arc: Euler-Bernoulli under either shear model; quarter circle; the user's k multiplies both bending flexibilities; axial and torsional flexibility unmodified; no shear term (T4-I7 definition; section-bases §3.6)
model.support_laws: DEC-067 as in kd5-nonlinear-active-set.md §0; r = (K u - f)_d is the support-on-pipe force with f including any cap at that node; states decided with the strict §2.2 conditions
model.exact_form: rational functions of pi with rational coefficients; Laurent forms printed as sums of q*pi^k; 'value' is the nearest binary64, decided by rational pi bounds 1e-110 apart

combinations.rule: In a model with any nonlinear support a mechanics combination is withheld by name, NONLINEAR_COMBINATION_REQUIRES_SOLVE (pf-nonlinear-operand-standing.md; exact-combinations.md §4, to be lifted onto EX in S5 by R-4 §3.5), except as admitted by decision OQ-1 (absolute-sum-srss-combinations.md §5.2): one term names a solved load case with factor exactly 1, there is at least one other term, and every other term names a combination with kappa exactly 0 (a difference, absolute sum or SRSS of kappa-zero operands, or a combination of those; undefined kappa does not qualify); such a combination is formed from rows with operand standing, not an equilibrium state, and these references give no values for it. Outside that shape the withholding is a model condition: the factors, the operands' states and the pressure do not matter. result_state_subtraction and range_envelope are formed from the operand cases' published rows, as derived results with operand standing, never an equilibrium state.
combinations.admitted_by_oq1_example: mechanics(1.0*O1-CONTACT + 1.0*E) with E = srss(D) and D = result_state_subtraction(O1-CONTACT, O1-LIFT)
withheld: every flat mechanics combination over the G, F or O models (all terms name load cases; OQ-1 does not apply), e.g. mechanics(1.0*G1) (singleton: no other term), mechanics(0.5*G1 + 0.5*G1-P0), mechanics(1.0*F1-SLIDE + 1.0*F1-P0-SLIDELOAD), mechanics(0.3*O1-LIFT + 0.7*O1-CONTACT) (unit factor sum: still withheld)
the same combinations with gap-bearing operands (G models); their operands are also unqualified
absolute-sum/SRSS forms outside OQ-1's admitted shape (absolute-sum-srss-combinations.md V-9)
formed_not_withheld: result_state_subtraction (e.g. G1 - G1-P0), range_envelope over G1, G2 and G1-P0
